title: Finite-table all-zero certification cost: exact theorem checks
status: Internally specified before saved check artifact; not external preregistration

theorem.budget_family_requirement: Contains every positive integer power 4^j up to its maximum, including 4^0=1
theorem.objective: Expected distinct unit-cost queries on the all-zero fixed-label table
theorem.decision: All declared target risks are at most a predeclared threshold, or abstain
theorem.comparator: All nonanticipating adaptive audits uniformly valid over fixed labels in [0,1], with almost-sure finite certification at the all-zero table

controls: No labels, model calls, downloaded data, or random outcomes enter these calculations.
Cost certificates concern the stated independent-inclusion audit, not the existing anytime engine.
Use exact rational arithmetic for rank laws, lower cost bounds, and upper cost bounds.
A rational upper bound on log(1/delta) and an odd Taylor polynomial give a conservative cost bound; displayed decimals are rounded summaries.
The universal factor follows from proof, not exhaustive checking over a finite grid.
Preserve all earlier frozen sources and result files.
